summary: Tested Newsroom Admin backend (10 pytest cases) and frontend (dashboard, tabs, stat cards, filter, modal, save draft, workflow advance, warning path). All backend and frontend flows passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Data reseeded via POST /api/news/seed?force=true before/after.

issues: Radix Dialog missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) in NewsEditorModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
PATCH /api/news/{id} does not validate `status` (only media_type). Fine today since status is not in NewsItemUpdate model, but note the split-endpoint design.
GET /api/news lists up to 1000; pagination not implemented (acceptable for MVP).
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/news/seed?force=true to reset the 5-item seed before and after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_news_api.py auto-reseeds via force=true fixture. All 10 pytest cases and full workflow UI (Pending → Approved → Rewritten → Published, warning-path when advancing Approved without rewrite) verified end-to-end.
